violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. -Employee donned glves and began food prep without hand wash.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. -Need to install proper plumbing for handwash sink and dishwashing sink.
Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Unapproved poison or toxic material was observed in food establishment. -Low splash bleach being used for sanitizer solutions.
